text: Al Jazeera reports DR Congo Ebola deaths have passed 5,000. Government data as of Oct 28: 10,274 confirmed cases, 4,992 deaths. Pulse Nigeria reports spread to Nigeria; there is no official statement yet.

judge.comment: Figures are consistent with the digest, but sources conflict (the tracker KPI still shows 4,478 deaths from CDC) and the Nigeria spread is a single-outlet, unconfirmed report. A human should check the framing.

factChecks.claim: DRC deaths above 5,000 per Al Jazeera
Government data as of Oct 28: 10,274 confirmed cases and 4,992 deaths
Pulse Nigeria reports spread to Nigeria, not officially confirmed

text: Israel's military has withdrawn from the West Bank city of Hebron after a 10-day operation, per Washington Post. Al Jazeera reported on Oct 30 that the siege had displaced thousands of residents.

judge.comment: Both claims are attributed to named outlets and match the tracker events. No casualty or displacement figure is invented.

factChecks.claim: Israeli military withdrew from Hebron after a 10-day operation (Washington Post)
Al Jazeera Oct 30: siege displaced thousands

text: How many Hezbollah fighters have been killed? Israel/IDF and independent estimates: 1,700–2,500. Hezbollah sources: 1,000+. Lebanon's health ministry counts 4,386 dead since Mar 2 with no combatant split. Hezbollah publishes no totals.

judge.comment: Genuine sourced disagreement, but the tracker gives no as-of dates for the fighter estimates; human check advised.

factChecks.claim: Israel/IDF and independent estimates 1,700–2,500 Hezbollah killed
